items.source: Create a new LocalSessionFactoryBuilder for the given DataSource.
items.translation: 为给定的 DataSource 创建一个新的 LocalSessionFactoryBuilder。

items.source: dataSource - the JDBC DataSource that the resulting Hibernate SessionFactory should be using (may be null)
items.translation: dataSource - 结果 Hibernate SessionFactory 应使用的 JDBC DataSource（可为 null）

items.source: resourceLoader - the ResourceLoader to load application classes from
items.translation: resourceLoader - 用于加载应用程序类的资源加载器

items.source: This is designed for programmatic use, for example, in @Bean factory methods; consider using LocalSessionFactoryBean for XML bean definition files. Typically combined with HibernateTransactionManager for declarative transactions against the SessionFactory and its JDBC DataSource.
items.translation: 这是为程序化使用而设计的，例如在 `@Bean` 工厂方法中；对于 XML Bean 定义文件，请考虑使用 LocalSessionFactoryBean。通常与 HibernateTransactionManager 结合使用，以针对 `SessionFactory` 及其 JDBC `DataSource` 实现声明式事务。

items.source: This builder supports Hibernate BeanContainer integration, MetadataSources from custom BootstrapServiceRegistryBuilder setup, as well as other advanced Hibernate configuration options beyond the standard JPA bootstrap contract.
items.translation: 此构建器支持 Hibernate `BeanContainer` 集成，以及来自自定义 MetadataSources 的 BootstrapServiceRegistryBuilder 设置，同时还支持超出标准 JPA 启动合约的其他高级 Hibernate 配置选项。

items.source: A passed-in Spring JtaTransactionManager needs to contain a JTA TransactionManager reference to be usable here, except for the WebSphere case where we'll automatically set WebSphereExtendedJtaPlatform accordingly.
items.translation: 传入的 Spring JtaTransactionManager 需要包含一个 JTA TransactionManager 引用才能在此处使用，WebSphere 情况除外，在该情况下我们将自动设置 WebSphereExtendedJtaPlatform。

items.source: Compatible with Hibernate ORM 7.1, as of Spring Framework 7.0. This Hibernate-specific factory builder can also be a convenient way to set up a JPA EntityManagerFactory since the Hibernate SessionFactory natively exposes the JPA EntityManagerFactory interface as well now.
items.translation: 与 Hibernate ORM 7.1 兼容，自 Spring Framework 7.0 起。此特定于 Hibernate 的工厂构建器也是设置 JPA EntityManagerFactory 的一种便捷方式，因为 Hibernate SessionFactory 现在原生暴露了 JPA EntityManagerFactory 接口。

items.source:
Note: If this is set, the Hibernate settings should not contain a JTA platform
setting to avoid meaningless double configuration.
items.translation: 注意：如果设置了此项，Hibernate 设置中不应包含 JTA 平台设置，以避免无意义的重复配置。

items.source: This enables autowiring of Hibernate attribute converters and entity listeners.
items.translation: 这启用了 Hibernate 属性转换器和实体监听器的自动装配。

items.source: Set a Hibernate BeanContainer for the given Spring ConfigurableListableBeanFactory.
items.translation: 为给定的 Spring ConfigurableListableBeanFactory 设置一个 Hibernate BeanContainer。

items.source: Build the Hibernate SessionFactory through background bootstrapping, using the given executor for a parallel initialization phase (for example, a SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor).
items.translation: 通过后台引导构建 Hibernate SessionFactory，使用给定的执行器进行并行初始化阶段（例如，SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor）。

items.source: Set the Spring JtaTransactionManager or the JTA TransactionManager to be used with Hibernate, if any.
items.translation: 设置要与 Hibernate 一起使用的 Spring JtaTransactionManager 或 JTA TransactionManager（如果有）。

items.source: Overridden to reliably pass a CurrentTenantIdentifierResolver to the SessionFactory.
items.translation: 重写以可靠地向 SessionFactory 传递一个 `CurrentTenantIdentifierResolver`。

items.source: Set a MultiTenantConnectionProvider to be passed on to the SessionFactory.
items.translation: 设置一个 `MultiTenantConnectionProvider` 传递给 SessionFactory。

items.source: Perform Spring-based scanning for entity classes, registering them as annotated classes with this Configuration.
items.translation: 执行基于 Spring 的实体类扫描，并将它们注册为带有此 `<code>` 注解的配置类。

items.source: Add the given annotated packages in a batch.
items.translation: 批量添加给定的注释包。

items.source: setCurrentTenantIdentifierResolver in class Configuration
items.translation: `setCurrentTenantIdentifierResolver` 方法在 `Configuration` 类中。

items.source: addPackages in class Configuration
items.translation: `addPackages` 类 `Configuration` 中

items.source: HibernateException - if scanning fails for any reason
items.translation: HibernateException - 如果因任何原因扫描失败

items.source: classLoader - the ClassLoader to load application classes from
items.translation: classLoader - 用于加载应用程序类的类加载器

items.source: metadataSources - the Hibernate MetadataSources service to use (for example, reusing an existing one)
items.translation: metadataSources - 要使用的 Hibernate MetadataSources 服务（例如，重用现有的一个）

items.source: packagesToScan - one or more Java package names
items.translation: packagesToScan - 一个或多个 Java 包名

items.source: SessionFactory initialization will then switch into background bootstrap mode, with a SessionFactory proxy immediately returned for injection purposes instead of waiting for Hibernate's bootstrapping to complete. However, note that the first actual call to a SessionFactory method will then block until Hibernate's bootstrapping completed, if not ready by then. For maximum benefit, make sure to avoid early SessionFactory calls in init methods of related beans, even for metadata introspection purposes.
items.translation: SessionFactory 初始化随后将切换到后台引导模式，立即返回一个 SessionFactory 代理用于注入目的，而无需等待 Hibernate 的引导完成。然而，请注意，如果此时尚未准备好，对 SessionFactory 方法的首次实际调用将会阻塞，直到 Hibernate 的引导完成。为了获得最大收益，请确保在相关 Bean 的初始化方法中避免早期调用 SessionFactory，即使是为了元数据内省目的。

items.source: Default is to search all specified packages for classes annotated with @jakarta.persistence.Entity, @jakarta.persistence.Embeddable or @jakarta.persistence.MappedSuperclass.
items.translation: 默认情况下，会在所有指定的包中搜索带有 `@jakarta.persistence.Entity`、`@jakarta.persistence.Embeddable` 或 `@jakarta.persistence.MappedSuperclass` 注解的类。

items.source:
Note: If this is set, the Hibernate settings should not define a
cache provider to avoid meaningless double configuration.
items.translation: 注意：如果设置了此项，Hibernate 配置不应定义缓存提供者，以避免无意义的重复配置。

items.source: Set the Hibernate RegionFactory to use for the SessionFactory.
items.translation: 将 Hibernate 的RegionFactory设置为 SessionFactory 所用。

items.source: Specify custom type filters for Spring-based scanning for entity classes.
items.translation: 为基于 Spring 的实体类扫描指定自定义类型过滤器。

items.source: Juergen Hoeller
